name: Due For Viral Load (ETL)
description: Patients Due For Viral Load - ETL Based Version using mamba_fact_patients_latest_viral_load_ordered fact table

config.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT base.patient_id AS client_id
FROM (WITH latest_vl_episode AS (SELECT patient_id, viral_load_clinical_date, is_suppressed, is_unsuppressed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY COALESCE(viral_load_clinical_date, '1900-01-01') DESC) as rn FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode), active_art_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card) SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS client_id FROM active_art_patients a LEFT JOIN latest_vl_episode v ON a.client_id = v.patient_id AND v.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL AND (v.viral_load_clinical_date < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) OR v.viral_load_clinical_date IS NULL)) base
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate) indicators ON indicators.client_id = base.patient_id

SELECT DISTINCT base.patient_id AS client_id
FROM (WITH latest_vl_episode AS (SELECT patient_id, viral_load_clinical_date, is_suppressed, is_unsuppressed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY COALESCE(viral_load_clinical_date, '1900-01-01') DESC) as rn FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode), active_art_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card) SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS client_id FROM active_art_patients a LEFT JOIN latest_vl_episode v ON a.client_id = v.patient_id AND v.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL AND (v.viral_load_clinical_date < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) OR v.viral_load_clinical_date IS NULL)) base
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate) indicators ON indicators.client_id = base.patient_id
SELECT viral_load_clinical_date FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY viral_load_clinical_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT result_numeric FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND result_numeric IS NOT NULL ORDER BY viral_load_clinical_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN is_suppressed = 1 THEN 'Suppressed' WHEN is_unsuppressed = 1 THEN 'Not Suppressed' WHEN result_qualitative IS NOT NULL THEN result_qualitative ELSE 'Unknown' END FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode WHERE patient_id = :patientId ORDER BY viral_load_clinical_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN viral_load_clinical_date IS NULL THEN 'Never Had VL' WHEN viral_load_clinical_date < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) THEN 'Overdue (>12m)' WHEN viral_load_clinical_date < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 'Due (>6m)' WHEN is_unsuppressed = 1 THEN 'Unsuppressed - Followup Needed' ELSE 'Recent VL' END FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode WHERE patient_id = :patientId ORDER BY viral_load_clinical_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT order_date FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND order_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT current_regimen_at_order FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND current_regimen_at_order IS NOT NULL ORDER BY viral_load_clinical_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, viral_load_clinical_date, :endDate) FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY viral_load_clinical_date DESC LIMIT 1
